acceptance_matrix.expect: No basename exclusion at any depth; only exact held-root private-map path plus receipt transaction/device/inode is excluded and every decoy scans.
Finite frozen write-confinement scope can be authoritatively CLEAN; every regular file streams regardless size, symlink text is bounded/nofollow, and whole workspace remains diagnostic only.
No-replace rename capability resolves before root, lock, stage, or transaction mutation; Linux/unsupported absence leaves zero artifacts.
Component implementation verdict is separate from external P0-v10/human authority; status stays provider-free pending and noncountable.
Any unlisted role/path denies in memory; chronology packet roles deny without fixed-chain authorization.
G3 conditional branches, bounded reads, public-binding-first private read order, lock ownership and race fences remain exact.

failure_policy: Unreadable, racy, type-changing, special, oversize symlink target, identity mismatch, unsupported capability, out-of-scope write, absent chronology authorization, malformed chain, or external authority gap denies its exact operation; whole-workspace diagnostics never grant CLEAN.
preconditions: Preserve every v1-v6 byte and mode as OPEN/revoked history.
No provider, network, bytedcli, scheduler, account, credential, email, business, host, or live effects.
Empty trust pins deny before private-map read.
